description:
Fantastic Investment Opportunity for sale. Video Tour Available on Request 

A well-located THREE STOREY freehold commercial unit in the heart of Hanley City Centre, with the added potential to create a self-contained residential flat upstairs (subject to planning). This property offers an excellent opportunity for investors, business owners, or developers seeking a mixed-use income stream. This Prominent city centre retail unit has display windows & door to front with rear yard. 

Kingsland Estates suggest that potential investors make their own enquiries to the local authority in order to satisfy themselves that their proposed use is authorised in planning terms.

EPC is pending.

Kingsland Estates suggests investors make their own enquiries into the business rate payable / business rate relief which may be available for this property.

Location & Local Amenities:
The property is located within Stoke-on-Trent city centre (Hanley), the retail and cultural
hub of the region.
• Shopping & Retail: Minutes from The Potteries Centre (90+ shops) and Hanley
Market, ensuring consistent local and visitor traffic.
• Leisure & Entertainment: Close to Cineworld at The Hive, Regent Theatre, and
The Potteries Museum & Art Gallery.
• Parks & Green Space: Hanley Park nearby with 60 acres of landscaped gardens,
boating lake, and sports facilities.
• Transport Links: Excellent connectivity via Stoke-on-Trent Railway Station (1.3
miles), city bus routes, and nearby car parks
